verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Temporal feature that exposes a custom webhook URL to receive external HTTP requests and start a workflow run with the payload. Temporal Clients and SDKs can start Workflow Executions, but these are developer building blocks for writing your own HTTP handler, not the capability itself. Schedules are time-based triggers, not HTTP ingress.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload
